name: domain-driven-design
description: Domain-driven-design practice skills. Today it actively maintains a consuming project's ubiquitous-language glossary: resolves ambiguous or overloaded terms, records canonical language and rejected synonyms, sharpens what-it-IS definitions, and routes entries to already-known bounded contexts without discovering boundaries.

glossary_file.title: Glossary file name
glossary_file.description: File name curate-language proposes for a bounded context's glossary when the repository has no glossary convention. A file name, never a path. docs/conventions/domain-driven-design.yaml overrides this.

glossary_map_file.title: Glossary map file name
glossary_map_file.description: File name curate-language proposes for the root context map once more than one bounded context exists. A file name, never a path. docs/conventions/domain-driven-design.yaml overrides this.
